xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #5736

plan.title: perf(lifecycle): activation/widen PRs take 21–42 min to merge; extra heads and re-runs cost more than CI speed

narratives.Description: Activation and thin file_scope-widen PRs currently take 21-42 minutes to merge because of extra heads, body-fix merge-gate re-runs, and leftover/activation races. This story cuts that latency with narrow offline pre-push checks, docs-impact relocation off the merge gate, dropping the CI closing-keywords duplicate, and a leftover-before-activation refuse.
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Recut-1 Bound 6256466667 (Target-digest sha256:d93daf97137f2c194fd5862e486f0885000b5ebae72835d00c7b090006939ffb): cut activation/widen merge latency via narrow pre-push trio, offline deft-story admission, advisory file_scope coverage warn, docs-impact branch-gate relocation, drop CI closing-keywords duplicate, leftover-before-activation order + thin executable refuse. Reject list binding. allocation_plan_id through-merge-5791-5814-5736-5804-5805-2026-10-22.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive through-merge operator, I want activation and thin file_scope-widen PRs to merge in about one CI round, so that Prefer-A Bound stories are not blocked for 21-42 minutes by extra heads, body-fix re-runs, and leftover/activation races.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Add narrow pre-push trio guidance for activation/widen (docs-impact --body-file --base-ref, pr:check-closing-keywords --body-file, CHANGELOG check) in swarm skill; not full pre-pr. 2) Offline deft-story identity admission in pr-closing-keywords when prNumber is null (canonical parse + brief/diff identity; forbid token-presence-only). 3) Advisory in-brief file_scope coverage warn from durable brief fields only (never write file_scope; never lift from issue prose). 4) Move docs-impact off merge-gate-primary/failover onto branch-gate job types opened+synchronize+reopened+edited. 5) Drop verify:closing-keywords from check:framework-source/check:merge; keep local + branch-gate. 6) Swarm leftover-before-activation order text + thin executable refuse when cohort leftover-complete is outstanding. 7) Review-cycle names gh run rerun --failed for body-only fixes. 8) CHANGELOG Unreleased for #5736.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Eight Prefer-A Recut-1 Bound remedy limbs (P1-P4) are independently testable acceptance criteria; collapsing them would hide the executable leftover-land refuse that reminted Stop 1 P4.

items.title: Activation-widen narrow pre-push trio: docs-impact --body-file --base-ref, pr:check-closing-keywords --body-file, CHANGELOG check (not full pre-pr)

narrative.Acceptance: Given an activation or thin widen PR body file, when the narrow pre-push trio runs before first push, then docs-impact, closing-keywords, and CHANGELOG checks execute without invoking full pre-pr.

x-directive/disposition.reason: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5827 squash-merge (Tracking #5736).

items.title: Offline deft-story identity admission without PR number (canonical parse + diff/brief identity; forbid token-presence-only green)

narrative.Acceptance: Given a brief-land shaped diff and a body with or without deft-story marks and prNumber null, when offline identity admission runs, then missing/wrong/partial marks hard-fail and token-presence-only cannot pass.

x-directive/disposition.reason: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5827 squash-merge (Tracking #5736).

items.title: Advisory in-brief file_scope coverage warn from durable brief fields only (never write file_scope; never lift from issue prose #3835)

narrative.Acceptance: Given an activation/widen brief with durable path fields, when the advisory coverage warn runs, then it warns on uncovered named paths without writing file_scope or reading issue prose.

x-directive/disposition.reason: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5827 squash-merge (Tracking #5736).

items.title: Docs-impact branch-gate relocation: remove from merge-gate-primary/failover; job types opened+synchronize+reopened+edited

narrative.Acceptance: Given ci.yml and branch-gate.yml, when docs-impact is relocated, then merge-gate-primary/failover no longer run it and branch-gate runs it on opened, synchronize, reopened, and edited.

x-directive/disposition.reason: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5827 squash-merge (Tracking #5736).

items.title: Drop CI duplicate closing-keywords from check:framework-source/check:merge; keep local + branch-gate signal

narrative.Acceptance: Given Taskfile check:framework-source deps, when the CI duplicate is dropped, then verify:closing-keywords is absent from that graph while local and branch-gate checks remain.

x-directive/disposition.reason: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5827 squash-merge (Tracking #5736).

items.title: Leftover-before-activation order text: leftover-complete land -> refresh base -> prepare activation -> land -> dispatch

narrative.Acceptance: Given through-merge/swarm skill prose, when operators prepare the next cohort activation, then the ordered leftover-complete land then refresh then activate sequence is stated without claiming core-phase-5-6 already covered it.

x-directive/disposition.reason: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5827 squash-merge (Tracking #5736).

items.title: Thin executable leftover-land refuse at cohort activation prepare/open when preceding leftover-complete is outstanding

narrative.Acceptance: Given an outstanding cohort leftover-complete land, when activation prepare/open runs, then the thin leftover-land gate refuses with remediation to land leftover first; after merge/fetch it admits.

x-directive/disposition.reason: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5827 squash-merge (Tracking #5736).
